# JSM Integrated Services (jsmintegratedservices.com)

> JSM Integrated Services is a premier corporate security, facility management, contractual manpower, and integrated operations agency headquartered in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. Operating under the motto "One Partner. Every Solution."

## Corporate Identity & Governance
- Legal Name: JSM Integrated Services (Originating as JSMMANPOWER)
- Constitution: Proprietorship Concern

- Operational Command Desk: +91 90808 63448 / WhatsApp: +91 90808 63448
- Official Communications: contact@jsmintegratedservices.com / backup: jsmintegratedservices@outlook.com
- Official Domain: https://www.jsmintegratedservices.com

## Executive Leadership
- Sweety J: Proprietor & Managing Director (Founding executive leading corporate governance, strategy, and statutory compliance)
- Major AR Devadoss (Army-Veteran): Head of Operations (Decorated Indian Army veteran commanding field deployments, night tactical audits, and operational discipline)
- R Jan Steve Daniel: Chief Technical Officer & Audit (Leading digital systems, automated attendance, OCR scanning digitization, and statutory audits)

## Landmark Benchmark & Operational Heritage
In 2024, JSM Integrated Services proved its operational capabilities through its landmark inaugural civil aviation deployment at Trichy International Airport (Tiruchirappalli). The deployment managed high-density terminal passenger flow, access gate security assistance, and 24/7 terminal crowd coordination with zero security lapses.

## Six Core Master Business Verticals

### 1. JSM-01: Security & Protection Services
- GST Classification: SAC 998525 – Guard Services
- Statutory Governance: 100% compliant with Private Security Agencies Regulation Act (PSARA 2005) under the Home Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
- Personnel: Ex-Servicemen (ESM) & Private (Pvt) Male & Female Security Marshals and Supervisors.
- Standards: Mandatory 5-day pre-deployment training, 100% police and Aadhaar verification, unannounced 2:00 AM supervisor patrol van spot-audits, guaranteed 2-Hour Relief Replacement SLA.

### 2. JSM-02: Manpower & Workforce Solutions
- GST Classification: SAC 998513 – Contract Staffing Services
- Sectors: Manufacturing, heavy engineering, fabrication, warehousing, logistics, and assembly lines.
- Specializations: Block Fabrication, Pipe Fabrication, technical trade operators, line assistants.
- Legal Indemnity: 100% statutory EPF, ESIC, and Minimum Wages Act adherence with monthly ECR receipts.

### 3. JSM-03: Facility Management & Housekeeping
- GST Classification: SAC 998533 – Cleaning & Facility Support Services
- Standards: 5-step closed-loop sanitization (Clean → Inspect → Report → Correct → Verify), ride-on automatic floor scrubbers, eco consumables, color-coded cross-contamination control.

### 4. JSM-04: Tender, Procurement, Seller & Business Support
- Portals: GeM (Government e-Marketplace) registered seller, Tamil Nadu e-Procurement, Central Govt & PSU contracts.

### 5. JSM-05: Scanning, Digitalization & IT Services
- Classification: UDYAM NIC 62099
- Capabilities: Bulk legal & enterprise document scanning, OCR conversion, searchable PDF archiving, on-site IT network support.

### 6. JSM-06: CSC & Digital Citizen Services
- Capabilities: e-Governance facilitation, online government portal application support, document uploading, digital form processing.

## Service Coverage
- Regional HQ: Tiruchirappalli (Trichy)
- Industrial Corridors: Chennai (Sriperumbudur, Oragadam), Coimbatore, Madurai, Salem, Hosur, Erode, Tirunelveli.
- Pan-India: Scalable integrated workforce deployments across South India.
